text: The Universal Digital Law Codex should require smart contracts to carry clear, human readable terms alongside their coded protocols, so that the parties' assent to automated terms satisfies the common law standard of mutual understanding.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218

isBasedOn.name: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era

abstract: For example, UDLC mandates that smart contracts incorporate clear, human-readable terms alongside coded protocols, ensuring that parties' assent to automated terms meets the common law standard of mutual understanding.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: smart contracts intended to be enforceable as common law contracts
